title: Vibrant Argentinian Tofu Bake
description: A flavorful and herbal Argentinian dish featuring marinated tofu, perfect for a date night, and suitable for a satvik-friendly diet.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, chimichurri sauce, garlic, oregano, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the tofu marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, toss the diced red bell pepper and zucchini with a little bit of olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
In a baking dish, arrange the marinated tofu in a single layer.
Top the tofu with the bell pepper and zucchini mixture.
Bake the dish in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
